odia: ଜର ଅଇଲା ଧାନକୁଟା ବେଳକୁ ଜର ଛାଡ଼ିଲା ଭାତ ଫୁଟା ବେଳକୁ
title: A fever with pointed timing
literal_meaning: Fever came at paddy-pounding time; fever left at rice-boiling time.
explanation: The paired arrivals make the timing conspicuous: illness accompanies one stage of food preparation and disappears at another. Our reading hears a possible teasing suspicion about avoiding the harder work. The source does not prove that anyone pretended to be ill, and boiling rice is not yet eating it. The contrast can carry an accusation without making that accusation true.
meaning_odia: ଖାଦ୍ୟ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତିର ଗୋଟିଏ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ଜର ଆସେ, ଅନ୍ୟ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ଛାଡ଼େ—ଦୁଇ ସମୟକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ି କଥାଟି ନଜର ଟାଣେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ କଠିନ କାମ ଏଡ଼ାଇବା ପ୍ରତି ଟାହିମିଶା ସନ୍ଦେହ ଶୁଣାଯାଇପାରେ। କେହି ମିଛରେ ଅସୁସ୍ଥ ହୋଇଥିଲେ ବୋଲି ଉତ୍ସ ପ୍ରମାଣ ଦିଏନାହିଁ; ଭାତ ଫୁଟିବା ମଧ୍ୟ ଖାଇବା ନୁହେଁ। ବିରୋଧରେ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଆସିପାରେ, ତାହା ସତ ହୋଇଯାଏନାହିଁ।
english_summary: Our reading notices suspicious timing without treating it as proof of pretence.
odia_summary: ସମୟର ମେଳରେ ସନ୍ଦେହ ଉଠିପାରେ, ଛଳନାର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: In a reading discussion, someone quotes the two timings and laughs at the apparent convenience. Another points out that illness can change and asks what the line actually establishes. This imagined exchange separates a joke from evidence about a sick person.
cultural_context: The dictionary defines fever abatement. No medical explanation, diagnosis, work instruction or documented household incident is established; the teasing inference is editorial.
